title: Product Release and GCP Deployment

scientific_routing.scientific_claim: Gate 08 remains negative; this gate evaluates independently evidenced product release and deployment only.

architecture.description: Public Streamlit web service plus private FastAPI API service that also hosts the MCP endpoint.

web.name: vietragops-web
web.responsibility: Public demo UI only; no admin mutation controls; calls the private API with a Cloud Run identity token.

api.name: vietragops-api
api.responsibility: FastAPI product API, governed document lifecycle, version-aware retrieval, and authenticated MCP.

iam.web_to_api: Cloud Run service-to-service ID token; web runtime receives run.invoker on the API service only.
iam.operator_to_api: Approved operator identity may invoke the private API for controlled E2E and rollback evidence.
iam.path_level_rule: Do not use Cloud Run IAM as a public/private path split; every mutation and MCP capability remains application-controlled or service-private.

mcp.authentication: Cloud Run IAM authentication for the private service; local static bearer remains local-only.
mcp.origin_policy: Exact configured HTTPS origins only; missing or wrong Origin is rejected.
mcp.tools: Read-only approved tools only; no public admin, filesystem, URI conversion, or rejected Gate 08 method tool.

cloud_storage.durability: Cloud Storage objects are the durable source of truth; local files are only ephemeral caches and conversion scratch space.
cloud_storage.write_rule: Immutable object names plus generation-preconditioned pointer updates; conflicts fail typed and never overwrite silently.
cloud_storage.retention: Bounded lifecycle rules and soft-delete/version recovery are required; no unbounded candidate or artifact retention.

cloud_sql.reason: Explicitly outside the confirmed scope. GCS optimistic registry/release pointers must satisfy the persistence contract; Cloud SQL requires a new evidence and approval checkpoint.

minimum_api_roles: roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor on approved secret resources only

secrets.handling: Names, version existence, bindings, and redacted metadata only; values are entered by the user through a secure Google Cloud interface and never read or recorded by the agent.

cloud_product.multi_key_rotation: disabled; only one GROQ_API_KEY secret is permitted
cloud_product.failure_visibility: typed provider failure and fallback metadata must remain visible to API and audit clients

cost_controls.stop_rule: At USD 24 total observed GCP spend, stop cloud mutations and ask the user; never exceed USD 30 or silently raise limits.

rollback.procedure: Capture healthy revision and image digest; deploy candidate with no traffic; smoke test; move traffic to candidate; move 100 percent back to healthy revision; verify; restore intended final revision; record revision names, digests, and traffic states.
rollback.in_flight_requests: must be allowed to complete and recorded

acceptance.PASS: Every mandatory local, image, security, persistence, browser/API/MCP, failure, and rollback criterion passes with source commit, image digest, revision, and cost evidence.
acceptance.PARTIAL: A release is deployed but one or more mandatory criteria are not executed or remain incomplete; no production-readiness claim is allowed.
acceptance.BLOCKED: Approved project, billing, account, IAM, secret entry, budget, or environment precondition is unavailable without new approval.
acceptance.FAIL: A mandatory behavior, security boundary, persistence contract, immutable identity, or rollback test fails.

explicit_exclusions: rescoring old Gate 07 or Gate 08 predictions under changed semantics
production use or public claim of the rejected Gate 08 alignment method
automatic billing changes, plan upgrades, recharge, commitments, or subscriptions
